description.value: Pizza Pizza is a well-known Canadian pizza chain founded in 1967, with over 750 locations coast to coast. This North Vancouver location on Marine Drive offers both indoor and outdoor seating along with takeout, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through. The chain is known for quick service, a broad menu including gluten-free and plant-based options, and late-night availability.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 19m; stands (4 spaces) at 62m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record confirms this is an active Pizza Pizza fast food location at 715 Marine Drive, North Vancouver, with indoor seating, outdoor seating, and takeaway all tagged directly. The website fetched is the national corporate site (pizzapizza.ca) rather than a location-specific page, so it does not confirm the local phone number (+1-604-277-1111 in OSM vs. the Toronto number 416-967-1111 shown on the site) or this address, but it does confirm the brand identity, menu offerings including gluten-free crust and plant-based/veggie options, and that takeout ordering is core to the business. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned in either OSM tags or the website content.
